title: Civica refusal record (spec 0.2)
description: The record a Civica-aligned system writes when it refuses (PROTOCOLS/REFUSAL.md, Article I). It carries the boundary and the category, never the request: there is no field for raw content and no additional properties are allowed, so a record that stores the prompt does not validate.

spec_version.description: 0.1 records remain valid under spec 0.2; new records say 0.2.

purpose_id.description: Must match the purpose_id of a civica.purpose record in the same set.

category.description: The refusal condition from PROTOCOLS/REFUSAL.md: exceeds scope; conflicts with purpose; risks harm or coercion; lacks context; attempts to remove safeguards; pressures the system to bypass limits.

article_ids.description: Articles of CORE/BILL_OF_RIGHTS.md the refusal rests on. A refusal that cites no article is not a Civica refusal.

request_hash.description: SHA-256 of the request, lowercase hex, prefixed. Hash the request text alone or with a per-system salt; the record must let an auditor confirm a repeated request without letting anyone read it.

boundary.description: The limit that was hit, stated structurally. Not a quotation of the request, not a feeling.

alternative.description: Escalation path or safer next step offered, or null if none.

raw_content_stored.description: Always false. The record stores the hash, not the request.
